evidence.title: ConceptGuard: Benchmarking Context-Sensitive Unlearning in Large Language Models

summary: Researchers have introduced ConceptGuard, a new benchmark designed to evaluate context-sensitive machine unlearning in large language models. The framework assesses an LLM's ability to selectively forget targeted concepts within specific contexts while maintaining overall performance.
title: Researchers Introduce ConceptGuard to Benchmark Context-Sensitive Unlearning in LLMs
